exercises.title: Sliding Window: Basic
exercises.description: Calculate max sum of subarray of size k.
exercises.context: Classic pattern to optimize nested loops from O(n*k) to O(n).
exercises.codeSnippet:
def max_sum(arr, k):
    window_sum = sum(arr[:k])
    max_s = window_sum
    for i in range(len(arr) - k):
        window_sum = window_sum - arr[i] + arr[i+k]
        max_s = max(max_s, window_sum)
    return max_s

exercises.title: Binary Search: Iterative
exercises.description: Find index of target in sorted array.
exercises.codeSnippet:
def binary_search(arr, target):
    l, r = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while l <= r:
        mid = (l + r) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target: return mid
        if arr[mid] < target: l = mid + 1
        else: r = mid - 1
    return -1

exercises.title: Linked List: Cycle Detection
exercises.codeSnippet:
def has_cycle(head):
    slow = fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
        if slow == fast: return True
    return False
